name: slop-geneva
description: A Geneva city simulation built with three.js, WebGPURenderer and TSL, from swisstopo and OpenStreetMap data.

scripts.data:gwr: mkdir -p tools/data/cache/gwr && curl -sSf -o tools/data/cache/gwr/ge.zip https://public.madd.bfs.admin.ch/ge.zip && unzip -o -q tools/data/cache/gwr/ge.zip -d tools/data/cache/gwr
scripts.data: npm run data:osm && npm run data:areas && npm run data:trees && npm run data:terrain && npm run data:decks && npm run data:sitg && npm run data:roadway && npm run data:geo && npm run data:marks && npm run data:lamps && npm run data:lights && npm run data:moorings && npm run data:surroundings && npm run data:ortho && npm run data:gwr && npm run data:facades && npm run data:recent
scripts.data:photomesh: node tools/build-photomesh.mjs plainpalais 2499600 1116800 2500000 1117300 && node tools/build-photomesh.mjs vieilleville 2500000 1117100 2500800 1117900
